title: Does not fit Glad/Hefty 13 gallon bags.
text: Does not fit Glad/Hefty 13 gallon bags.. Live the large opening but cannot get bags to fit. When  using the "arms" to hold the bag they won't stay in place to hold a 13 gallon bag. Good in theory but not in practice.

product_metadata.title: Rubbermaid Commercial Products Touch Top Trash Can/Wastebasket with Lid, 13-Gallon, Small Black Garbage Bin for Home/Kitchen/Bathroom/Bedroom/Office
features: TOUCH TOP LID: Convenient and easy to use one touch lid springs open for quick trash/recycling disposal
LINERLOCK TECHNOLOGY: LinerLock bag wires secure the trash bag to rim of the can and prevent the bag from slipping into the can
SEAMLESS, INTELLIGENT DESIGN: Durable seamless construction and strong plastic resin material make this can long lasting and easy to clean
PERFECT FOR ANY ROOM AT HOME: Rubbermaid's timeless designs are perfect for any room in the home, be it bedroom, nursery, garage, foyer, or kitchen. Great for business purposes as well
LARGE CAPACITY: This wastebasket was designed with convenience in mind. Large 13 gallon capacity means less trips to empty, and less bags needing to be bought
MADE IN USA: Recognized as a “Brand of the Century”, Rubbermaid is one of only 100 companies named as having an impact on the American way of life. Rubbermaid products are made in Wooster, Ohio
description: The Rubbermaid 13G Black Touch Top is a convenient and simple solution for your kitchen waste. The latch easily springs open and clicks shut for quick recycling or trash disposal. The Linerlock(TM) bands hold liner bags in place to prevent slipping and messes and the seamless design makes the container easy to clean.
